title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: Conceptualized by musical legend and fashion designer Kanye West, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 is a certified icon for its elusive nature and cult appeal that defines an era. This 'Cloud White Non-Reflective' iteration—issued in September 2019—features a Primeknit bootie constructed with translucent monofilament side stripes and a tonal lacing system. Full-length Boost technology is encased in a tubular rubber sole unit, while the back heel pull is removed from this colorway.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN ‘Honey Flux’ showcases a seamless upper constructed from lightweight yellow polyester with lateral-side ‘700’ branding in reflective metallic silver. Contrasting black accents land on the padded tongue, no-tie elastic laces, and no-sew overlays with additional reflective detailing. A sculpted polyurethane midsole houses full-length, drop-in Boost cushioning. Underfoot, the rubber outsole features a herringbone traction pattern for superior grip.

title: YEEZY BASKETBALL KNIT
description: The adidas Yeezy Basketball Knit ‘Slate Azure’ combines fully knit construction with responsive cushioning. In addition to neutral beige and grey tones, the Primeknit upper weaves in reflective threads throughout the forefoot in a vibrant blue finish. The sock-like build is secured with traditional lace closure and a solid black calf-length cuff. Anchoring the basketball-inspired silhouette is a full-length Boost midsole, reinforced with a semi-translucent TPU cage and a seamless heel counter. Underfoot, a durable blue rubber outsole features a grippy herringbone tread.

title: USA Flag Bomber
description:
Background: Donned by Ye during his announcement for a potential 2024 presidential run, which did not end up occurring.

Allegedly made with fabric from a real American flag that was sourced from an antique store.

It was rumored that laws surrounding the usage of an American flag as clothing discouraged Ye from wearing it again, but that is not the case. U.S. flag code is more of an advisory on flag etiquette than an actual penalizing law.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 11/25/2022 at the Sweetgreen Office
• 11/27/2022 at Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles

title: HD-10 (CUCK)
description:
Background: Designed by Ye, Taha Elghanai, and Muad Elghanai.

The HD-10 is based on Fostex’s Army Physical Training Zip Up. The HD-10 was made in Spain on 05/15/2025. The fit and overall design were later updated on 05/30/2025. 

Ye and Taha Elghanai hand-pressed the first version together, with Ye personally hand-placing the print location. 

This process also marked the creation of the Black version. Ye had a Black version made that featured the text “CUCK". Ye wore this version on 06/11/2025 and on other occasions for his album "CUCK" during that time; it was later changed back to “SZNX".

Documented wear by Ye:
• 06/11/2025 at the airport
• 06/??/2025 at The Balance Rehab Clinic in Mallorca
